$comment: The per-site capability manifest. CueTap only intercepts uploads on sites listed here. A site that is absent is left alone — an honest 'not supported' beats a silent cue loss. 'mode' records how the site's upload mechanism was observed: 'network' means the composer posts the file bytes over HTTP and CueTap can enrich the request; 'input' means the composer reads the file client-side, so CueTap attaches the enriched text alongside the file instead.

sites.name: ChatGPT
sites.notes: Composer posts multipart/form-data to the file-upload endpoint. The file part is addressable and the request carries no body signature.
